_lisezmoi: Paramètres du site (RECETTE §4), relus sur les documents cités le 2026-10-20. Les capacités par véhicule ne sont pas ici : elles viennent de data/facts/ par scripts/build-data.py (src/data/towing.json).

conventional._source: gm_2026 p. 8 and p. 9: tongue weight 10% to 15% of the loaded trailer weight for conventional trailering

atMaxRating._source: gm_2026 p. 8: when towing the maximum trailer weight, the maximum tongue weight is 10% for conventional and 15% for gooseneck/fifth-wheel

fifthWheel._source: gm_2026 p. 8 and p. 28: kingpin weight 15% to 25% of the loaded trailer weight

hitchWeight._source: ram_hd_2025 notes 12: trailering equipment weight 75 lb conventional, 70 lb gooseneck, 250 lb 5th wheel (2025 Ram 2500 chart)

ramAssumptions._source: ram_hd_2025 notes 9 to 11: ratings per SAE J2807, passenger weight 300 lb, options weight 100 lb

gmIncluded._source: gm_2026 p. 7: base curb weight plus 150 lbs each for the driver and a front passenger

brakes.who: Ford (all models in its towing guide)
brakes._source: ford_2026 p. 6: separate functional brakes should be used for trailers weighing more than 1,500 lbs. loaded

_trailerClasses_source: gm_2026 p. 7, minimum recommended hitch by trailer class
_water_source: usgs_water: 62.366 lb per cubic foot at 60 °F; a US gallon is 231 cubic inches (0.13368 cubic foot): 62.366 x 0.13368 = 8.34 lb
